author: mustafa
body: For the bit of time that I've been on Avicus, I've always found it annoying to have to join every game just to find the map that I want to play in the rotation of a server. If we could get a section on the website that would tell you rotations of servers and the amount of players in the server it'd be ALOT easier :D. What do you guys think of the idea?
